title: Fit to my target lands in the target's range and adds what the meal is missing
why: Coach Milan 22 November 2026, 17:41 to 17:47, after an onboarding call: a tester scanned eggs (PD about 8.5) and asked Fit to my target; Chef Mealan added whey protein, PD 17 against her target 5.3, where a cook would add carbs and balance the meal. 17:47: follow the range of the user's target, no new formula; take the food preferences into account and add what is missing to balance it; several options, as in the chat (eggs with toast, fruit), carbs when the diet has them; a keto-like diet would add fat instead. 22:46: the cards are an interesting feature, I like it; make them more often available. 22:51: redraw with the route changed. 23:06: in the test only one egg was on the plate. 23:08 to 23:10: why would Chef Mealan miss in the first place? The input was wrong for him. The app should show correct suggestions, because it was asked very precisely.

opportunity.job: Turn what I have into a balanced meal for my target.
opportunity.kind: A wrong result: more protein on a plate that already has too much.
opportunity.why_now: Fit to my target is the first thing a new tester tries on the Plate.

problem: The instruction to Chef Mealan says keep the meal at or above the protein target, and the app's check only refuses an idea under the target. There is no upper side, so an idea far above passes. Nothing tells him the plate is already above the target and needs energy, not protein.
story: When my plate already has more protein than my target, I want Fit to my target to add what the meal is missing, in foods I like, so that the meal lands in my range and is balanced.
proposed: The range already in the app: the On plan chip of Foods covers 0.9 to 1.5 times the target (for a target of 5.3: 4.8 to 8.0). With the AI on, a plate with no meal set makes Fit ask which meal first, in the meal line, with one tap; then the ideas come for that meal. A plate above the range goes to Chef Mealan's ideas, also when it is near the meal's size. Fit to my target aims into the range, and the app shows only ideas that land in it: an idea above the range is never shown; Chef Mealan is asked once more with the reason, and the new idea replaces it; a second miss is left out. Chef Mealan is told what the meal is missing: the meal's share of the day's carbs and fat, against what the plate holds, and, when the plate is above the range, that the protein is there and to add no protein food. The quick fit, when the AI is off, adds a base from your foods to a plate above the range, never a protein food. Diet, taste, kitchens and the library keep working as today.
open: The readout says fits your plan for any PD at or above the target, 13.4 included. DT338 shows the range; the words stay as they are here.
checks: Area: the Plate. The unit tests with new ones for the range check, the route and what Chef Mealan is told, the build, a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC8, and every Plate walkthrough that uses Fit to my target, the ideas or the quick fit (make-meal, chef-dinner, two-breakfasts, plate-fixes, kitchens-and-steps, fab-and-fit and the rest), about 15 to 20 minutes. make-meal's lunch at PD 10.1 against 6.4 is above the range, so that walkthrough changes with this ticket. One new line on screen, so the German sweep too. The model evals for the meal ideas get cases for a plate above the range.
decision: Direction agreed 22 November 17:47; route asked for 22:46 and 22:51. Drawn again 22 November 2026 for Coach Milan's look. No Go, so nothing is built.
now: One egg on the Plate, PD 8.4, against the target 5.3: already above its range, 4.8 to 8.0. With no meal set (since 0.3.157 no meal is guessed), Fit uses the quick fit: it adds the food with the most protein in your foods, 40 g whey, PD 17.0, as in the test. With a meal set, Chef Mealan's ideas come; he is told to keep the meal at or above the protein target and adds whey, cottage cheese or quark, PD 8.6 to 9.4, and the check lets them pass. The plate says fits your plan either way.
looked_at: A new formula for a balanced meal: not chosen, 17:47, follow the range the app already has. Leaving the check as it is and only changing what Chef Mealan is told: not chosen, the check is what stops an idea that is still above the range. Guessing the meal again when none is set: not chosen, 0.3.157 stopped guessing; one tap asks it. Showing an idea above the range as a miss, as misses under the target are shown: not chosen, 23:10, he is asked precisely, so the app shows only correct suggestions.

ac.title: The ideas land in the range
ac.text: Given one egg for breakfast, PD 8.4, with the target 5.3 and its range 4.8 to 8.0, when I tap Fit to my target, then every idea shown lands in that range, for example egg on wholegrain toast with tomato and cottage cheese at PD 6.3

ac.title: An idea above the range is asked again, never shown
ac.text: Given Chef Mealan answers with eggs with cottage cheese and skyr at PD 10.1, when the app checks it, then it is not shown, he is asked once more with the reason, and his new idea, egg with potatoes and ajvar at PD 6.1, takes its place; an idea that still lands above the range is left out

ac.title: He is told what the meal is missing
ac.text: Given the plate is above the range, when Chef Mealan is asked, then he is told the plate has the protein and to add no protein food, and what the meal is missing against the day's carbs and fat, for example carbohydrate: the plate 2 g, this breakfast about 85 g

ac.title: A very low carb day adds fat
ac.text: Given my carbs and fat are set to Very low carb, when the plate is above the range, then he is told the missing part is fat, not carbs

ac.title: Ideas anyway follows the range
ac.text: Given the plate already fills the meal and I tap Ideas anyway, when the small additions come, then they land in the range too

ac.title: No meal set: Fit asks which meal
ac.text: Given one egg on the Plate with no meal set and the AI on, when I tap Fit to my target, then the meal line opens and one line says Which meal is it? Pick it, and Chef Mealan finds ideas for it; once I pick Breakfast, the ideas come for a breakfast

ac.title: Above the range goes to Chef Mealan
ac.text: Given a breakfast set and a plate above the range, near the meal's size or not, when I tap Fit to my target with the AI on, then Chef Mealan's ideas come, not the quick fit

ac.title: The quick fit adds no protein above the range
ac.text: Given the AI is off and one egg for breakfast, PD 8.4, when I tap Fit to my target, then the quick fit adds a base from my foods, for example 59 g wholegrain bread, PD 5.3, never whey

unchanged: Diet, taste, the kitchens you cook, allergies and the foods in your library steer the ideas as today.
An idea under the target is refused as today.
The meal's size: within 10 % of what the meal should be.
With the AI off, or a plate near its meal's size and in the range, Fit uses the quick fit as today.
Three ideas, Put it on the plate and Other ideas. An idea under the target or the wrong size is still shown as a miss with why, as today.
details: The range is the one the app already has: 0.9 to 1.5 times the target (BAND_EDGES in src/goal.ts), the On plan chip of Foods.
What the meal is missing: the meal's share of the day's carbs and fat (the day's split on Me), against what the plate already holds. The kind of food that is short is the one he adds.
A food Chef Mealan names that is not in your foods has no fibre value, so the plate shows fi? (DT342, if Coach Milan says so).

The pictures are the real app on one scratch build of main, not committed. Chef Mealan's answers are given in place of the AI: before, the kind of answer the tester got; new, the answer once he is told what the meal is missing: the first answer has one idea above the range, the second answer replaces it.
The quick fit's base: from your foods, bread, oats, rice, potatoes or pasta, with a PD under the target; the one closest to the target first.
short: Fit to my target lands in the range and adds what the meal is missing
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
